description: Accurate word and character counts for drafts, essays, and snippets — using the same rules as ibm.io/wordcount. Returns words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time. Includes an in-chat widget for quick visual summary. Text is processed in memory and not stored. For private editing with word goals, link to the full offline browser app.

defaultPrompt: Open a word counter I can type in
Count words in: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
How many words, sentences, and reading time in my draft?
